prepared_for: Raymond Ayac and the Nado's Jewellery team
title: Re: Nado's Jewellery at Forever Is Now
subject: Re: Nado's Jewellery at Forever Is Now
body:
Hi Raymond,

Following up on my note of 16 October, here are three options for hosting guests around the Meet Her launch.

Two press days around the launch, an evening at the exhibition for your closest clients, or a two-day creator stay that includes the Grand Egyptian Museum. Nado's keeps the collection and the launch; NOYA handles arrivals, stays, transfers and dinners.

With the exhibition opening on 4 November, a short call this week would leave time to book. Would that work?

Best,
Adam Elshazly
Founder, NOYA Concierge
noyaconcierge.com

sources.fact: The sixth Forever Is Now runs from 4 to 28 November 2026 at the Pyramids of Giza.
sources.source: Ahram Online, 'Art D'Egypte announces 6th edition of Forever Is Now at Giza Pyramids'

sources.fact: It is the first edition led primarily by women artists.
Art D'Égypte's programme for this edition lists the launch of Nado's Jewellery's Meet Her collection.
sources.source: artdegypte.org event listing, Forever Is Now 06

sources.fact: Nado's is an Egyptian jewellery brand; Maha El Sharafy is co-founder and creative director.
NOYA wrote to Raymond Ayac on 16 Oct; no reply yet; follow-up due 20 Oct.
Collection details, launch date within the exhibition and guest plans are not on public record.

review: Adam approved attaching the concept (17 Oct); a cold contact gets the one-page version under the levels, the full concept is held until Raymond replies. ATTACH APPROVED PDF before sending on 20 Oct.
